scenes.headline: How an open agent drives a browser from screenshots
scenes.sub: Fara1.5 from Microsoft: pixels in, one action out, at 4B, 9B and 27B.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Basil! Fara1.5 is an open browser agent that works from screenshots alone. Here's how it sees, acts, and learns.

scenes.text: Skip the DOM. Show the model three recent screenshots, let it think, and have it emit one atomic action, with coordinates read straight from pixels.

steps.say: Each step, Fara sees the goal, its history and the last three screenshots. No DOM, no accessibility tree. Just pixels.
It reasons in text, then emits exactly one action, like click, type or scroll, with coordinates predicted from pixels.
The browser updates, a new screenshot comes in, and the loop repeats.

steps.note: trained to ask_user at 8 critical-point types
steps.say: Meta-actions handle long tasks. Memorize keeps a fact past the screenshot window. Ask user pauses before critical points, like payment or sending a message.

scenes.title: Where the training data comes from
scenes.say: Nearly all the training data comes from its own synthetic pipeline.

items.say: A GPT-5.4 solver attempts a task, with a simulated user who withholds details.

items.text: On the live web, or sandboxes
items.say: It works on the live web, or in six sandboxed apps written by a coding agent.
Three independent verifiers must pass each trajectory.
The result: roughly two million training samples.

scenes.title: Online-Mind2Web success rate
scenes.note: self-reported by Microsoft; the 4B only ties the weakest
scenes.say: The largest model scores seventy-two point three on Online-Mind2Web, ahead of three proprietary agents. The four-billion model only ties the weakest of them.

scenes.text: Pixels in, one action out is a general enough interface, but a small model doesn't get it for free.

recap: Three screenshots in, one atomic action out
Trained on trajectories its own pipeline made
The win over closed agents arrives at 27B
scenes.say: To recap: screenshots in, one action out, trained on its own verified trajectories, and scale that pays.
